release_notes: Pigeon Poker 1.5.18 fixes the cash-table pot display being hidden behind the upper-centre seat panel. Pot plaque, pot chips, community cards and street label now use a coordinated height-aware layout so the pot stays clear of player panels and other table elements. Existing 174-situation preflop policy, postflop reasoning, all-in runout reveal, stack USD/BB toggle, separate Casino window, mandatory Baccarat squeeze, wallet and ledger behavior, NL500/NL1000, and the one-time $270 refund marker are preserved.
